crossRefs.note: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.
They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for…
As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,
He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on…
Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.
The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will…
All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you. They hiss and gnash their teeth. They say, “We have…
but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of…
and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.
and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.”
Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That…
and will cut him in pieces, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of…
Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom…

translations.web: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.
translations.bsb: On hearing this, the members of the Sanhedrin were enraged, and they gnashed their teeth at him.
